title: The global test-runs GET returns every registered run unpaged (4.7 MB / 2995 rows); bound or page it before any UI or agent polls it
outcome: The host's global test-run listing returns a bounded page (with a continuation) or a bounded recent window by default, so a UI view or agent query never transfers the whole registry history in one response.
acceptance: The global test-run listing route returns at most a documented bounded number of rows per response, with a continuation or explicit window, and existing exact-ID GETs are unchanged.
Callers in the UI and launcher that list runs use the bounded form; none fetches the unbounded history.
Tests cover the bound, the continuation (or window) and exact-ID lookup; the full gate is green.
disposal_reason: Parent w-654bf2d34f93 (test-run registry) is completed and its code is landed, so this optional child continues as independent work — cleanup queue group 8 (Fable2's #802 order via Engram::Advisor), assigned to Termal::Sol-03d4 while the train is held.
